title_en: The Route That Changed: The Safe Mark

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: The tags carry the yard stamp. No royal seal.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: Good. Keep the captain's business out of this. Oakhaven has enough wounds of its own.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: The largest wolf follows the broken cart. It turns late. Give it a wide corner.
